I am an old man, 55 years, and I have never been to school. This small piece of land, only 0.15 hectares, I am planting beans mixed with other crops — that is our way here in Zomba. I do not waste the fertilizer coupon on beans; if I get FISP this year, that urea and NPK goes to my maize plot. For beans, the plant makes its own food in the soil, so I just put a little manure from my goats and use the seed I saved from last harvest. My wife and I will work it ourselves — no money to hire people for such a small plot.
